newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end weaker, off early lows.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end weaker, off early lows.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly lower on Thursday, but off their early lows as private investors' short-covering gathered force, traders said.
Prices ranged from unchanged to 1.0 yen per kilogramme lower. Benchmark April was flat at 140.9 yen.
Rubber prices edged lower earlier in the day, and the benchmark April hit its life-of-contract low of 139.7 yen.

But a perception that the market was oversold fuelled some short-covering, mainly in distant months. "Activity was spurred by technicals. The market was looking for direction," one trader said. -- Tokyo Commodity Desk +81-3-3432-7391
